scope: Declared literal materials, actual raw R50 native matrices and full installed mathematical surface.
restrictions: Original comparison reports retain wrong phase/branch hypotheses and pre-upgrade reader failures.
Negative native SRES falls back to PEC without warning; DiffMoM instead rejects invalid physical material.
Bad Equation comparisons/conditionals/positive exponent sign are unsupported and remain rejected.
Printed variable values are quantized and are not the high precision full-S reference.
This validates material expressions, not graph-only FORMAT or arbitrary complex-valued physical materials.
